description:
Run due diligence on a US public company in one call: profile, revenue/profit growth, margins, leverage and cash ratios computed from SEC filings, key filings with links, and plain-English summaries of its latest 8-K material events.

$0.03 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

ticker.description: US stock ticker, e.g. "NVDA". Give this or cik.

name: company_due_diligence
title: Company due diligence
